subject: compact-hook-view
kind: repair
result: pass
revision: 09561d29d5bc7952bbb789fdbc437755b3a8a74c
evidence: Baseline, before any edit: `uv run pytest tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_views.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` gave 9 failed, 44 passed (R1, R3, R4, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R12 failed; R5 and R11 passed). After the fix all six acceptance verify_commands pass from the write root: compact-hook-view (R4) 1 passed; compact-hook-view-closed (R5) 1 passed; compact-hook-view-handoff (R11) 2 passed; compact-hook-view-links (R7) 1 passed; compact-hook-view-order (R10) 1 passed; compact-hook-view-roles (R6) 1 passed. Full run after the fix: 5 failed, 48 passed; the 5 failures are R1, R3, R8, R9 and R12, the next task's tests (R1 and R12 fail on the 9000-char budget, R12 got 14905 chars; R8 and R9 fail because no effort is omitted yet; R3 fails because constraints still come after the effort sections). Byte-identity check: HANDOFF, PLAN, VERIFICATION, STATUS and ROADMAP rendered from the real store with HEAD views.py and the new one are identical. Files changed: orchestra/views.py and orchestra/stage/hooks.py. views.py: added HOOK_ROLE_NAMES, HOOK_ROLES and HOOK_VIEW; added link: bool = True to _record_line (link=False drops the id link, owner still shown as _(owner: x)_); split render_view into _group_records and _group_lines with unchanged output; added live_efforts(records) and hook_handoff_sections(records) returning (effort, text) ordered by recorded_at of the active scope-effort position, newest first, ties by name, efforts with no such position last; hook_constraints filters on the set of live efforts. hooks.py: cmd_start builds the effort text from views.hook_handoff_sections under a # Project Handoff title; _truncate and MAX_HANDOFF_BYTES remain.
observations: cmd_start rendered the full HANDOFF view, which has id links and the Latest Proof and Backlog roles, so R6 and R7 failed. It listed efforts in alphabetical order, so R10 failed. hook_constraints took only the first active position's effort, so R4 failed. R5 passed before the fix because only one effort was ever matched, and still passes because closed efforts have no active goal or position.
root_cause: There was no hook-specific view. cmd_start reused the full render_view(HANDOFF) and truncated that output by bytes. The constraints filter used one effort, the first active position found, instead of the set of live efforts.
verdict: pass
